player_prompt.intro:
D kečč imiraz {player_id} di Chopsticks. Di t-ufriw-ik, xtar yiwen seg:
  + Aɣraz: '[attack M O]'  anda M=ifassen-ik (0 neɣ 1), O=ifassen n umsaddaq (0 neɣ 1).
    - Aḥḍad n ifassen n umsaddaq yettazmer s ifassen-ik; ma yella >=5, yettuɣal 0.
  + Aẓway: '[split L R]'  akken ad tesseḍreḍ ifassen-ik s L akked R (L+R = ṣeddaw-ik).
Ṣay s yiwen kan seg yisallen-nni.

invalid_move.split_no_change: Ad ibeddel Split amek ara tefreḍ afus-ik.
invalid_move.invalid_command: Aseɣwen ur yezmir ad yili. Sumer “[attack M O]” neɣ “[split L R]”.

game_action.attack: P{player_id} yettwali P{opp_id} n yideb {opp_idx}: yeqqel d {opp_val} ɣer {new_val}.
